# those of the C-level files in metadata/c_level_corrections.csv.
# 2026-11-19: ISWR scaled so that the spring (April-May) albedo of dry snow stays at its value of 1996-2004. No document explains the change: the albedo steps from 0.83 (1995-2004 springs
# 0.81-0.84 in all 8 years) to 0.94-0.99 (2005-2010) and 0.89-0.96 (2010-2020) with no change of surface; the dry-snow stations of the network are at 0.82-0.86 in spring (CP2 0.82).
# CARRA ssrd (independent) says it is the ISWR channel: ISWR/CARRA falls from 1.05-1.12 (1996-2004) to 0.88-1.05 after 2006 while OSWR/CARRA stays at 0.85-0.96. The factors are the ratio of the
# median spring albedo of the period to the reference 0.832 (0.948 and 0.919); they are an estimate (+-0.02 in albedo from year to year) and not a sensor calibration. The boundary of the second
# period is the change from the CR10X to the CR1000 logger (2010-05-09).
